svg.title: Directory permissions.
svg.desc: A notes directory contains note.txt before a rename and draft.txt afterward. Directory r lists names, x allows access through known names subject to file permissions, and w plus x permits adding, removing and renaming entries. The example changes a directory entry rather than file contents. Additional restrictions can apply.
svg.text: r: list names. x: access known names through this directory.
Access to the file's contents still needs the file's own permissions.
w + x: add, remove or rename names inside the directory.
Renaming changes a directory entry, not the file's contents.
Removing a name also changes its parent directory: a read-only file can
still be removed if directory rules allow it. Other restrictions can apply.
